d95.b5.473.text: Four hundred seventy-three. I've measured it with my knees.

d95.b5.supper.text: Come for supper if you're up that way. Bring something. Not in a can.

d95.b5.names.bob.text: Walt named all of us. Gene was Deacon, the one church man who wasn't. I'm Teach. It's the stove, not the school.

d95.b5.names.frank.text: I'm Whiskey. Plastic bottle, since 1985. And that one, that's Sparky, for life.

d95.b5.round.paid.text: Coffee and bars for the table. Carol rings it up before you ask.

d95.b5.denny.again.text: There you are! Sit, sit. You want a coffee? I'm getting one.

d95.b5.spoon.text: Bob hands you one of the spoons.

d95.b5.bet.end.text: That's dark. Reel in. We'll weigh them at the fire.

d95.b5.slide.hint.text: The slide, held up against the view.

d95.b5.slide.match.text: Gene's slide lines up from the water off the creek mouth: the dam, the notch, the ridge. This is where Walt stood.

d95.b5.pan.cook.text: Walt's pan. Bob held it out; I cooked in it.

d95.b5.slides.wall.text: The projector hums. Carol turns the carousel to the first slide.
